prompt:
Create a transparent pixel-art atlas with exactly TWO square cells side-by-side: TOP then REAR principal views of the same wood trophy shelf shown in the canonical source. The labeled contact shows source plus accepted FRONT/RIGHT/LEFT/BOTTOM. Preserve item count, identity, and shelf levels from the native source. True orthographic views, no perspective.

TOP: show the shelf's actual upper board footprint and only the top-most objects that rise above it: the hanging plant canopy/cap, one gold trophy cup rim/top, and the narrow cap/stand edge of the tilted framed photo. Do not show a full frontal photo image or entire trophy faces from above. The small gold ornament and other objects sit on the LOWER shelf, occluded by the upper shelf board; do not add them to TOP.
REAR: show the back panel of the wood shelf and the reverse backs/stands of the upper plant, single cup and photo frame. Do not repeat frontal object faces. The small gold lower-shelf object remains behind/occluded by the rear shelf board and must not appear to the left of the shelf. Preserve source wood color, top-item positions and full shelf width. Center on transparent background, no labels/shadows/guide marks/clipping; crisp pixel clusters.
